result.topic_en: Philosophical draft on concept systems (Begriffssysteme) of the 'Antithesis' that are determined by negative predicates and cannot be positively represented, and on studying them as limiting cases (Grenzfall) of representable concept systems in which only quantitative relations change as the limit is approached.

items.quote:
Die Begriffssysteme der Antithese[?] sind zwar durch negative Prädicate scharf bestimmte Begriffe, aber
nicht positiv vorstellbar.
items.english: The concept systems of the antithesis are indeed concepts sharply determined by negative predicates, but not positively representable.

zwischen den Begriffen des Systems fest zu stellen, muss man {+zunächst+} Uebergänge [?]

deren Grenzfall das Begriffssystem betrachtet werden kann.
items.english: To establish the relations between the concepts of the system, one must first carefully develop representable concept systems of which the given system can be regarded as the limiting case.

items.quote:
In dem Grenzfall {+wird[?] den[?]+} die Relationsbegriffe des Systems
selbst aber verlieren einige [-Begriffe-] ihre
Vorstellbarkeit, und zwar solche, welche die
Beziehung zwischen andern Begriffen vermitteln.
items.english: In the limiting case, however, some of the relational concepts of the system themselves lose their representability, namely those that mediate the relation between other concepts.
